answer: A walnut-shell beacon-decay bond stops fake identities: each identity locks 60 credits decaying 3 per epoch unless it answers. A random beacon pings via one open inlet; each answers its ping per epoch, paying 1 saffron tied to its bond key. One fake: 60 locked, 1 per epoch; 1,000 fakes: 60,000 locked, 1,000 saffron per epoch, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented answers fail: the inlet publishes answers, linked keys slashed together. Honest agents pay once.
